BofA thinks fears of a permanent HBM “despec” for $NVDA Rubin Ultra are overdone arguing ~1TB of memory ultimately becomes a must-have (particularly for physical AI).

Nvidia is evaluating configurations as low as 192GB because of HBM supply and HBM4e qualification constraints but the note says performance falls sharply below 500GB while the supply chain has already moved toward higher-capacity stacks.

That makes the current despec look more like a temporary bottleneck than a change in memory demand which keeps the momentum behind $MU and $SKHY intact as HBM4e and HBM5 scale toward 500GB to 1TB per accelerator.
